_comment: negative control: the required assertion per the T086 task line is ONLY that primary != E9 (complete evidence must never default to unclassifiable). primary=='E4' is this fixture's own grounded, evidenced claim (see input.yaml header) and is asserted too, but the checker treats the not-E9 assertion as the load-bearing one per constitution 11.4.201(1): if a future correct implementation reasonably resolves E4 vs a contributing-mechanism nuance differently but still never emits E9 here, that is the false-positive guard doing its job, not a fixture failure -- the test script reports BOTH results distinctly so this distinction is never silently blurred.
